notes:
Both points from the earlier refusal are fixed. The "G8" gate reference is gone. SD-1 and SD-6 now cite "agent judgement" instead of record:brief. Section 6 and PQ-P5 say clearly that no input defines synthetic data rules.

I checked every statement in feat.prototype.md against feat.prd, org.design_library, the step brief and MEMORY.md:
- DL-1 to DL-4 quote the design library word for word.
- The states (ST-1 to ST-5), the screen inventory (SC-1) and the PRD check in section 8 match the cited sources: AC-13 to AC-21, NFR-1 to NFR-3, NFR-6, NFR-7, NFR-10, P-A2, PQ-2, PQ-4 and OQ-B2/B8/B9/B10.
- Decisions D-2026-031, D-2026-044 and D-2026-050 and lessons L-007 and L-011 are applied correctly.
- Section 9.2 lists the carried questions exactly as feat.prd (section 6) does.
- The tie-break order in WF-1 (SYN-INV-002 before SYN-INV-003) matches P-A2's ascending text order.

The synthetic values (days 75/42/31/30/90 and the amounts) do not come from any source. That is acceptable here: the workbook action asks for synthetic data, and the output labels these values as made-up and not facts. The other presentation choices (greyscale, right-aligned amount, margin annotations, no row actions, no page shell) are all marked "design choice (agent judgement)". None of them invents a fact.

Completeness: the outcome is low-fidelity wireframes plus a FigJam/Figma Make prompt, delivered in text form only. That is justified, because the design library says Figma is not connected and api:github is the only approved connector. PQ-P6 raises it for follow-up.

Missed point (minor): the agent read ap_portal/src/ap_portal/index.js. Its existing formatAmount uses Number(value).toFixed(2), which converts the amount to a float. That is directly relevant to NFR-3 and OQ-B10, and the prototype does not mention it.

The prototype's flow edge "valid or empty paid_date" leading to delays_by_vendor is a simplification. AC-4 filters to paid records that have a paid_date inside the function, so the edge is not wrong.
